items.title: Daemons can now send traces to Vercel Tracing
items.summary: can now send OpenTelemetry traces to , allowing you and your agents to inspect background worker operations alongside the rest of your project's traces.Vercel DaemonsVercel TracingVercel provides each daemon with a Unix socket for receiving OTLP/HTTP traces and sets the socket's path in .VERCEL_OTEL_SOCKET_PATHUpgrading  to version 2.3.0 or later enables automatic trace export for Node.js daemons using the default configuration. The SDK detects this socket and sends the spans your worker records to Vercel.@vercel/otelThese spans are available through the , which can search by service name within a project and return JSON for your agents.Vercel CLILearn more in the .daemon tracing documentationRead more
